results.name: Standing Cable Hip Flexion
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and fasten it to one ankle, facing away from the machine.
Hold a support and stand tall.
Drive your knee forward and up to hip height against the cable.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your torso still.
Don't lean back to lift the knee.
results.description: Standing Cable Hip Flexion is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Abdominals.

results.name: Standing Calf Raise Resistance Band
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band under your forefeet. Hold the handles of the band by your sides.
Slowly lift your heels off the floor by pushing through your forefeet, raising your body upwards.
Continue lifting until you are standing on your forefeet, feeling a strong contraction in your calves.
Slowly lower your heels back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on pushing through your forefeet, avoiding excessive pressure on your toes.
Move slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and avoid injury.
Ensure the resistance band is secure and provides enough challenge without compromising form.
results.description: Standing Calf Raise Resistance Band is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Hamstrings.

results.name: Standing Calf Raises Smith Machine
instructions: Stand in front of the Smith machine bar and place both hands on the bar keeping your arms straight. Place your forefeet shoulder-width apart on a low platform, heels extended to the floor.
Slowly lift your heels off the floor by pushing through your forefeet, raising your body upwards.
Continue lifting until you are standing on your forefeet, feeling a strong contraction in your calves.
Slowly lower your heels back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on pushing through your forefeet, avoiding excessive pressure on your toes.
Move slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and avoid injury.
Keep your knees slightly bent to avoid strain or injury of your joints.
results.description: Standing Calf Raises Smith Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a smith machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Hamstrings.

results.name: Standing Side Leg Raises
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips for balance.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and slowly lift your right leg out to the side as high as you comfortably can, keeping it straight.
Hold the raised leg for a second, and slowly lower your right leg back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to your left leg.
tips: Focus on keeping your torso upright and avoid leaning to the side.
Keep your supporting leg slightly bent to maintain balance.
Start with a smaller range of motion and gradually increase it as your strength improves.
results.description: Standing Side Leg Raises is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abductors.

results.name: Step Up on Chair Bodyweight
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy chair with your feet shoulder-width apart, keeping your posture upright.
Place your left foot firmly on the chair, ensuring your entire foot is supported.
Push through your left heel to lift your body onto the chair, bringing your right foot up to stand on the chair with both feet.
Step down carefully with your right foot first, followed by your left foot. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you step up and inhale as you step down.
Focus on pushing through your heel to engage your glutes and quadriceps.
Ensure the chair or bench is stable and secure before starting the exercise.
results.description: Step Up on Chair Bodyweight is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves, Core.

results.name: Sumo Squat Over Shoulder Resistance Band
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward. Place a resistance band under your feet.
Hold the ends of the resistance band with both hands near your shoulders, palms facing forward and elbows pointing down.
Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back. Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then push through your heels to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up to the starting position.
Focus on keeping your knees in line with your toes to avoid inward collapse.
Ensure your chest stays up and avoid leaning forward excessively.
results.description: Sumo Squat Over Shoulder Resistance Band is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Adductors, Hamstrings.

results.name: Sumo Squat in Between Legs Resistance Band
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward. Place a resistance band under your feet.
Hold the ends of the resistance band with both hands in between your legs, keeping your hands at hip level.
Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back. Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then push through your heels to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up to the starting position.
Focus on keeping your knees in line with your toes to avoid inward collapse.
Ensure your chest stays up and avoid leaning forward excessively.
results.description: Sumo Squat in Between Legs Resistance Band is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Adductors, Hamstrings.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Hip Bridge
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about knee height. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, placing your heels in the handles.
Engage your core and press your heels into the handles, lifting your hips towards the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, ensuring your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them back down.
Focus on using your glutes and hamstrings to lift your hips, avoiding excessive use of your lower back.
Use a mat to provide cushioning and support for your back.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Hip Bridge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back, Core.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Leg Curl
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about knee height. Lie on your back with your heels placed in the handles and your legs extended. Keep your arms on the floor by your sides for support.
Engage your legs and lift your hips over the floor by bending your knees and pulling your heels towards your glutes.
Slowly extend your legs back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you pull your heels towards your glutes and inhale as you extend your legs back.
Focus on using your hamstrings and glutes to perform the curl, avoiding excessive use of your lower back.
Use a mat to provide cushioning and support for your back.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Leg Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Core.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Side Squat
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handle close to the floor. Stand to the side of the suspension trainer, placing your right foot in the handle and keeping your left foot firmly on the floor. Keep both hands to your sides.

Bend your left knee and push your hips back to lower into a squat while reaching with both hands to touch the floor with your fingertips. Keep your right leg straight through the squat and allow it to extend to the side.
Push through your left heel to return to the starting position, keeping your right leg extended.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you lower into the squat.
Ensure your knees track over your toes to maintain proper alignment.
Keep your chest up and shoulders back to maintain proper posture.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Side Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Adductors, Calves.
